Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit

Class DeviceVerificationController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit.DeviceVerificationController
All Implemented Interfaces:
DeviceVerificationPageApi
@Controller public class DeviceVerificationController extends Object implements DeviceVerificationPageApi
Serves the device verification page, as the contract apis/auth-server/web-pages/auth-server-pages-v1.yaml describes it through the generated DeviceVerificationPageApi: the form where the user types the code the device shows. The form posts to the framework's own endpoint (POST /oauth2/device_verification); a request that already carries a code never reaches this controller, because that endpoint answers it. The page is also where the endpoint sends the browser back to, with ?error when the attempt failed and ?success when the device was approved.
